plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-09-30 from the official 2026-2027 Occidental College Catalog, 'Sample 4-Year Plan: Focus in Computer Science' (https://oxy.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2026-2027/catalog/programs-of-instruction/computer-science), for students required to take COMP 131 for the proficiency requirement. Occidental awards a Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science (verified via the catalog's 'Bachelor of Arts Degree' page and the 2026 Commencement program) - degree recorded as BA. Choice slots model the plan's generic slots: FYS courses are 4 units each (verified on official FYS course pages); Foreign Language 101 counted at 4 units (Oxy standard course value); Core Requirement and General Elective slots at 4 units as printed. COMP 101 recorded at 2 units as printed in the sample plan itself ('(2 units)') and on the official COMP 101 course description page; NOTE the catalog requirements table lists COMP 101 as 4 units - discrepancy documented, sample plan followed. Foreign Language 102 printed as '4 or 5 units' - counted at 4; a 5-unit FL102 would make the total 131. Term unit sums: Y1F 16, Y1S 16, Y2F 18, Y2S 16, Y3F 16, Y3S 16, Y4F 16, Y4S 16 = 130 total vs the College's 128-unit BA minimum - the sample plan exceeds the minimum by 2 units (3 if FL102 = 5). Prereqs: COMP 131 before COMP 229 / COMP 239 per Advising Information ('Once students have completed COMP 131, they should enroll in COMP 229 ... Students may also take COMP 239'); COMP 101 before COMP 390 per the department (oxy.edu: COMP 101 'required for all majors to take before their junior seminar'); COMP 390 before COMP 490 per the Junior/Senior Seminar sequence (390 offered spring junior year, 490 fall senior year). Six COMP electives satisfy the CS focus: three at 300-level, two in different subfields (AI, interfaces, security, systems/software, theory), at most two from the catalog's Additional Electives list. Placement: students with AP CS A 4/5 or qualifying self-placement skip COMP 131 and start at COMP 229.
